title: FORGE pin approval record, version 1
description: One owner approval (or supersede, or revoke) of one exact pin payload. Append-only: never edit or delete a record; add a supersede or revoke record instead. tools/approvals.py verify enforces this schema plus the cross-field rules it cannot express (folder and file names, hash of approved_payload, chain order, legacy rules). An approval covers data only: it never authorises a build, publish or deploy.

approval_id.description: UTC time the record was made plus 8 random hex digits. Also the file name: <approval_id>.json.

signal_id.description: The pin's signal_id. Also the folder name.

pin_version.description: 1 for the first record; every later record is the previous one plus 1.

supersedes.description: null on version 1; otherwise the approval_id of the current latest record.

batch_file.description: The docs/signals batch file that holds the pin (file name only). null on a revoke.

approved_payload.description: The pin's fingerprinted fields exactly as approved, in canonical form. null on a revoke.

payload_sha256.description: sha256 of approved_payload serialised with sorted keys, UTF-8 and no spaces: the same value as the pin's fingerprint in docs/signals. null on a revoke.

source_hashes.description: The sources behind the approved data. Unknown values stay null; nothing is filled in by guessing.

diff_from_previous.description: null on version 1; required on a supersede: what changed from the last approved version.

owner.description: The approving owner, by pseudonym. Never an email address.

approved_at.description: When the owner approved, with time zone. null only on a legacy record whose date was never recorded; no date is invented.

recorded_at.description: When this record was written, with time zone.

approval_reference.description: A short opaque ID and a one-line summary. No chat text goes into Git.

basis.description: explicit: approved for this record. legacy: records an approval given before the ledger existed (first approve only).

scope.description: The approval lets this exact data into the authority. It does not cover a build, publish or deploy.
